assumptions.text: Robot handles only protected instrument modules through qualified closed ports; physical atmosphere is never treated as a sample.
Processing can consume preexisting authorized observations without requiring fresh capture; it must retain exact authenticated dataset ancestry.
Branch graphs express logical dependencies, not undocumented historical specimen/sequence reuse. Each branch instance declares its data lineage.
Observatory and optical hazards remain inside qualified service boundaries. Missing safety/pose/device cards block execution.
Leakage checks and persistence baseline are original evaluation requirements; the source does not establish their complete implementation.
